name: chatgpt-desktop-community
description: Community desktop client for ChatGPT and Codex, powered by the local codex app-server

scripts.package:mac: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-codex-runtime.mjs darwin-arm64 && electron-packager . "ChatGPT Desktop Community" --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 --out=release --overwrite --prune=true --asar --app-bundle-id=com.ninotquyi.chatgpt-desktop-community --icon=assets/community-icon --extra-resource=release/codex-runtime-stage/codex-runtime --ignore="^/(release|\\.git|\\.omx|_analysis)($|/)" && codesign --force --deep --sign - "release/ChatGPT Desktop Community-darwin-arm64/ChatGPT Desktop Community.app"
scripts.package:mac:universal: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-codex-runtime.mjs darwin-universal && electron-packager . "ChatGPT Desktop Community" --platform=darwin --arch=universal --out=release --overwrite --prune=true --asar --app-bundle-id=com.ninotquyi.chatgpt-desktop-community --icon=assets/community-icon --extra-resource=release/codex-runtime-stage/codex-runtime --osx-universal.x64ArchFiles="Contents/Resources/codex-runtime/**" --ignore="^/(release|\\.git|\\.omx|_analysis)($|/)" && codesign --force --deep --sign - "release/ChatGPT Desktop Community-darwin-universal/ChatGPT Desktop Community.app"
